name: Paper
script_install:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper installation script
set -eu

PROJECT=paper
API="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}"
UA="atlas-panel/1.0 (https://github.com/luketaylor45/atlas)"
cd /mnt/server

SERVER_JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
MINECRAFT_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD_NUMBER="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"

download_jar() {
    url="$1"
    target="$2"
    echo "[Atlas] Downloading ${url}"
    rm -f "${target}.part"
    if ! curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "${target}.part" "${url}"; then
        echo "[Atlas] Error: the download failed." >&2
        rm -f "${target}.part"
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$(head -c 2 "${target}.part")" != "PK" ]; then
        echo "[Atlas] Error: the downloaded file is not a valid jar." >&2
        rm -f "${target}.part"
        exit 1
    fi
    mv -f "${target}.part" "${target}"
}

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "[Atlas] Using the supplied download URL"
    download_jar "${DL_PATH}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
else
    echo "[Atlas] Looking up Paper versions"
    VERSIONS=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "${API}")

    if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
        # Newest version that is not a pre-release or release candidate.
        VERSION=$(echo "${VERSIONS}" | jq -r '[.versions[][] | select(test("-") | not)] | .[0]')
    elif echo "${VERSIONS}" | jq -e --arg v "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '[.versions[][]] | index($v) != null' > /dev/null; then
        VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    else
        echo "[Atlas] Error: Paper has no version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "null" ]; then
        echo "[Atlas] Error: could not determine a Paper version." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "[Atlas] Installing Paper ${VERSION} (build ${BUILD_NUMBER})"
    BUILD=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "${API}/versions/${VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}") || {
        echo "[Atlas] Error: Paper ${VERSION} has no build ${BUILD_NUMBER}." >&2
        exit 1
    }
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "${BUILD}" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].url')
    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
        echo "[Atlas] Error: that Paper build has no server download." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    download_jar "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
fi

echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
echo "[Atlas] Finalizing installation"

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Minecraft version to install, or 'latest'. Current versions need Java 25; pick an older Java image for older versions.
